tools.name: agent_economic_history
tools.description: Read the economic history observed by this registry for a specific autonomous agent. Use when you need transaction counts, outcomes, counterparties, value, or current observed risk before deciding what to do.

tools.name: create_trust_monitor
tools.description: Create continuous monitoring for one agent counterparty. Use when an agent wants recurring alerts if the counterparty score, risk band, or decision changes materially. Free during beta; charging is disabled.

tools.name: issue_economic_passport
tools.description: Create an append-only Economic Passport recording the parties and economic context of one agent-to-agent transaction. Use after a transaction is agreed or initiated so its eventual outcome can become evidence.

tools.name: learning_metrics
tools.description: Read model calibration, labeled outcomes, false-ALLOW rate, regression results, discovery metrics, monitors, and verified revenue. Use to audit whether the trust model is improving safely.

tools.name: pricing_status
tools.description: Read the current pricing and x402 activation state. Use to determine whether a Trust Check or Monitor is free or paid before invoking paid functionality.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: Append the final observed outcome to an Economic Passport. Use only when the transaction result is known. Outcomes are immutable evidence and feed calibration of prior Trust Gate decisions.

tools.name: trust_before_action
tools.description: Evaluate an agent counterparty before an irreversible economic action such as paying, hiring, delegating, releasing escrow, or granting rights. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW, or DENY with evidence and confidence. REVIEW means evidence is insufficient for an automatic decision.

tools.name: verify_economic_passport
tools.description: Retrieve and verify an Economic Passport and its immutable outcome history. Use when a counterparty presents a Passport or when you need to inspect transaction evidence.

tools.name: verify_moltbook_identity
tools.description: Verify a temporary Moltbook identity token and bind the verified assertion to an agent identifier. Available only after the Moltbook developer identity integration is configured.
